subject: Proposal: Rolling Net Terms & Temporary Credit Window for OptiScale pilot
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@optiscale.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@optiscale.io>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot invoicing & temporary credit window question

Hi Jordan,

We’re finalizing the SOW for the OptiScale pilot and procurement has asked whether Redwood can support a short-term Net45 cadence (instead of Net30) for the first 90 days, plus a temporary credit window to smooth usage spikes while we ramp. High level: 3 months, monthly invoices, estimated monthly spend ~€45k, but ramping.

Two specific asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a capped credit line for the initial pilot (suggested €100,000) to avoid missed calls if usage spikes mid-cycle?
- How will VAT be handled on invoices to OptiScale Ireland (we’ll share VAT IDs but want confirmation of reverse-charge treatment)?

If viable, procurement will take a credit/terms addendum. We need this confirmed to close the PO next week.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Procurement, OptiScale
maria.gonzalez@optiscale.io
+353 87 555 1122
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@optiscale.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot invoicing & temporary credit window question

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear ask.

We can support a short-term Net45 for the pilot and offer a temporary credit buffer, subject to a brief credit verification and a capped amount. Proposed approach from our side:
- Temporary credit cap: €100,000 for the 90‑day pilot window
- Invoice cadence: monthly (Net45) with usage detail attached to each invoice
- Early-pay option: 1.5% discount if paid within 10 days (optional)

Looping in Neha (AM) and Marissa (Finance) to draft an addendum and confirm the operational pointers (attachments, GL references). Neha — can you share a recommended invoice schedule and the internal checklist for credit onboarding? Marissa — any concerns on provisional cap and credit monitoring?

Also, procurement — please send the billed entity name + VAT ID for reverse-charge confirmation.

If that sounds good I’ll send a one‑page addendum and a short mutual action plan link so procurement has everything to route.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@optiscale.io>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:38:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Pilot invoicing & temporary credit window question

Jordan / Maria — draft schedule attached.

Key points from Finance:
- We can do a provisional cap of €100,000 for 90 days with weekly usage checks; any sustained spike that risks breach will trigger a pre-notice and agreement to block overage until top-up/PO is received.
- Monthly invoices will be issued on the 1st business day of the following month (example: Nov usage invoiced Dec 1, due Jan 15 under Net45).
- We recommend an early-pay incentive as Jordan suggested (1.5% within 10 days) to reduce DSO.

Attachments: draft_payment_schedule.xlsx, optiscale_credit_worksheet.pdf (worksheets with projected consumption and cap scenarios).

Open items for legal:
- VAT handling (need VAT ID and whether OptiScale will accept reverse-charge).
- Add a 90-day trial terms clause and a simple credit addendum (one page).

Marissa — if finance approves the cap and monitoring cadence, I’ll convert the worksheet into a one-page addendum.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@optiscale.io>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Pilot invoicing & temporary credit window question

Neha / team — quick VAT/legal note.

- If OptiScale is invoiced to an EU-registered B2B entity and provides a valid VAT number, the invoice can normally be issued net of VAT under the reverse-charge mechanism. We will need their VAT registration number and the exact legal entity name.
- If OptiScale is invoiced to a non-EU entity or an EU entity without a VAT ID, VAT must be applied.
- For the credit cap: recommend a simple credit addendum (1 page) referencing the SOW, caps, monitoring cadence, and a provision to suspend service if the cap is breached and not remedied within 5 business days.

Attaching a short note: vat_requirements.md outlining required invoice fields and sample wording for the addendum.

Aditya Rao
Senior Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@optiscale.io>, OptiScale Procurement <procurement@optiscale.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 15:28:00 +0000
Subject: Final proposal: Net45 pilot cadence + €100k provisional credit cap (90 days)

Hi Maria / procurement team — thanks for the quick turn. Based on the convo above, here is the consolidated offer we can sign off on for the pilot: 

Offer summary:
- Term: 90-day pilot window (dates to align with SOW start).
- Credit cap: €100,000 provisional credit buffer for the pilot period.
- Invoice cadence: monthly (issued on the 1st business day of the following month).
- Payment terms: Net45 from invoice date.
- Early-pay option: 1.5% discount if paid within 10 days of invoice.
- Cap monitoring: weekly usage checks; we will notify at 85% utilization and block additional capacity if cap is breached and not remedied within 5 business days.
- VAT: invoices will be net of VAT if OptiScale provides a valid EU VAT ID and invoices are addressed to the EU entity. Please confirm billed entity name + VAT ID.

Next steps for procurement: 
1) Confirm billed legal entity and VAT ID (reply to this thread).
2) Marissa + Neha will prepare a 1-page credit addendum and payment schedule (attached).
3) We’ll put the addendum into DocuSign once you confirm — link to follow.

Links / refs:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654
- Draft addendum and worksheets attached (draft_payment_schedule.xlsx, optiscale_credit_worksheet.pdf).
- DocuSign will be sent for signature after VAT ID confirmation (DocuSign envelope prepared).

If that aligns with procurement’s needs, please confirm and we’ll route DocuSign today to hit your PO deadline.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
